decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a range of specialized backpacks including a large 70L hiking pack, a 45L tactical rucksack, an insulated cooler backpack, a disc golf bag, and a travel sling bag. I ultimately chose the W WINTMING tactical backpack (prod_backpacks_164) because it offers a versatile 45L capacity suitable for multiple outdoor activities, features waterproof construction, and maintains a strong 4.6 rating at a mid-range price point of $47.99, representing the best value for a general-purpose outdoor pack in this selection.
